sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在早上4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最棒的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天使用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一锅端食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮助您理解世界，充分过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可享受特别优惠，网址为 nytimes.com 加上斜杠 subscribe。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: Of the many charges and lawsuits filed against former President Trump, perhaps the most personal is playing out in a courtroom in New York City
sentences.zh: 在针对前总统特朗普提出的众多指控和诉讼中，也许最私人的诉讼正在纽约市的一间法庭内上演

sentences.en: in a case that could end in him losing control of his best-known buildings and paying hundreds of millions of dollars in fines.
sentences.zh: 这场官司可能会导致他失去对其最知名大楼的控制权，并支付数亿美元的罚款。

sentences.en: Over the past few days, my colleague Jonah Bromwich has been inside the courtroom watching as Trump's children and Trump himself have taken the stand.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几天里，我的同事乔纳·布罗姆维奇一直在法庭内旁听，看着特朗普的孩子们以及特朗普本人相继走上证人席。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, November 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月8日，星期三。

sentences.en: Jonah, thank you for taking a break in your busy schedule of being in the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 乔纳，谢谢你在法庭旁听的忙碌日程中抽出时间。

sentences.en: I'm very happy to be here.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: So, Jonah, you've spent the past several days in a New York City courtroom where, for the first time, the adult sons of Donald Trump and Donald Trump himself
sentences.zh: 那么，乔纳，你在纽约市的一间法庭度过了过去的好几天，在那里，唐纳德·特朗普成年的儿子们以及唐纳德·特朗普本人

sentences.en: have all taken the stand and testified.
sentences.zh: 生平第一次同时走上证人席并进行了作证。

sentences.en: And we're going to get to their testimony.
sentences.zh: 我们等会儿会讲到他们的证词。

sentences.en: But I want to start by asking you to just describe this case because there are so many cases against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 但我想先请你简单描述一下这个案子，因为针对唐纳德·特朗普的案子实在是太多了。

sentences.en: This is one of many.
sentences.zh: 这只是其中之一。

sentences.en: And it's a civil case, which is probably why I think it's gotten a lot less attention than all the criminal cases against Trump.
sentences.zh: 而且这是一起民事案件，这大概也就是为什么我认为它比针对特朗普的所有刑事案件受到的关注要少得多。

sentences.en: So just tell us about this case.
sentences.zh: 所以，给我们讲讲这个案子吧。

sentences.en: So this case was brought by New York's Attorney General, Letitia James.
sentences.zh: 这个案子是由纽约总检察长莱蒂蒂亚·詹姆斯提起的。

sentences.en: James ran for office in 2018, and she ran for office talking about Donald Trump a lot of the time.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯在2018年竞选公职，她在竞选期间大部分时间都在谈论唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: She's a Democrat, and she made clear he was in her sights.
sentences.zh: 她是一名民主党人，并且明确表示他成了她的目标。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And so she takes office in 2019, and shortly thereafter, Michael Cohen, who's a former fixer for Trump, he testifies in front of Congress.
sentences.zh: 她在2019年上任，不久之后，特朗普的前固定代理人迈克尔·科恩在国会进行了作证。

sentences.en: And I don't know if you remember this kind of from the fog of the Trump presidency.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是否还记得特朗普总统任期那种乱糟糟的时期里的这件事。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: But he testifies about some of the conduct that Donald Trump has undertaken that might be of interest to Congress.
sentences.zh: 但他作证谈到了唐纳德·特朗普采取的一些可能引起国会兴趣的行为。

sentences.en: And that includes manipulating the values of his property to get favorable loans from banks, from insurers.
sentences.zh: 其中包括操纵其财产价值，以便从银行和保险公司获得优惠贷款。

sentences.en: And so with Tish James in office...
sentences.zh: 所以随着蒂什·詹姆斯上任……

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Those comments quickly turn into an investigation.
sentences.zh: 这些言论迅速演变成了一项调查。

sentences.en: I am announcing that today we are filing a lawsuit against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我在此宣布，今天我们对唐纳德·特朗普提起诉讼。

sentences.en: And that investigation turns into a lawsuit that she files in 2022 against Trump and against his adult sons and against his company.
sentences.zh: 这项调查最终演变成她在2022年对特朗普、他的成年儿子们以及他的公司提起的诉讼。

sentences.en: The complaint demonstrates that Donald Trump falsely inflated his net worth by billions of dollars to unjustly enrich himself and to cheat the system, thereby cheating all of us.
sentences.zh: 起诉书表明，唐纳德·特朗普虚假夸大了数十亿美元的净资产，以实现不义之财并欺骗体制，从而欺骗了我们所有人。

sentences.en: And broadly, she's accusing him of exaggerating the values of a lot of his properties, his hotels, his apartment buildings, his golf clubs.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，她指控他夸大了许多资产的价值，包括他的酒店、公寓楼、高尔夫俱乐部。

sentences.en: And there's some really good kind of specific details in here.
sentences.zh: 里面有一些非常精彩的具体细节。

sentences.en: So for example...
sentences.zh: 比如……

sentences.en: Take Mr. Trump's triplex.
sentences.zh: 以特朗普先生的三层复式公寓为例。

sentences.en: You know, the triplex apartment in Trump Tower on Fifth Avenue?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，位于第五大道特朗普大厦的那套三层公寓？

sentences.en: One of the properties at issue is Trump Tower, and he has this triplex apartment in Trump Tower.
sentences.zh: 涉案的财产之一就是特朗普大厦，他在特朗普大厦里有这套三层复式公寓。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, this number is burned into my brain.
sentences.zh: 现在，这个数字已经深深印在我的脑海里了。

sentences.en: His triplex apartment is 10,996 square feet.
sentences.zh: 他的这套三层复式公寓面积为10,996平方英尺。

sentences.en: Nice big apartment.
sentences.zh: 很棒的大公寓。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But for years...
sentences.zh: 但多年来……

sentences.en: Mr. Trump represented that his apartment spanned more than 30,000 square feet.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生声称他的公寓面积超过3万平方英尺。

sentences.en: Trump was saying it was three times that big on the financial statements.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在财务报表上说它有那么大面积的三倍。

sentences.en: That was the value of it, as if it were 30,000 feet.
sentences.zh: 它的价值就是按3万平方英尺来算的。

sentences.en: And based on that inflated square footage, the value of the apartment in 2015 and 2016 was $327 million.
sentences.zh: 根据这个被夸大的面积，该公寓在2015年和2016年的估值为3.27亿美元。

sentences.en: To this date, no apartment in New York City has ever sold for close to that amount.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，纽约市从来没有哪套公寓的售价接近过这个金额。

sentences.en: Tripling the size of the apartment for purposes of the valuation was intentional and deliberate.
sentences.zh: 为了估值目的而将公寓面积扩大三倍是有意为之的蓄意行为。

sentences.en: Fraud.
sentences.zh: 欺诈。

sentences.en: Not an honest mistake.
sentences.zh: 这不是无心的错误。

sentences.en: So this is a great example of what he's accused of doing writ large.
sentences.zh: 所以这是他被指控整体实施这种行为的一个极好的例子。

sentences.en: He's exaggerating the number of square feet in the apartment.
sentences.zh: 他夸大了公寓的平方英尺数。

sentences.en: He's valuing it as if it were three times as big as it actually is.
sentences.zh: 他把它估值得好像比实际大三倍一样。

sentences.en: And that's the number that goes into the financial statement.
sentences.zh: 而这就是写入财务报表的数字。

sentences.en: And those financial statements go to banks and insurers.
sentences.zh: 这些财务报表则被交给了银行和保险公司。

sentences.en: To what end?
sentences.zh: 目的何在？

sentences.en: Overall, the attorney general says, by doing this, the loan terms were better.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，总检察长表示，通过这样做，贷款条款变得更好了。

sentences.en: The insurance terms were better.
sentences.zh: 保险条款变得更好了。

sentences.en: It gave him favorable treatment from those companies that he was doing business with.
sentences.zh: 这让他从与其有业务往来的那些公司获得了优惠待遇。

sentences.en: And she's asking for really serious punishments out of this.
sentences.zh: 她为此要求进行非常严厉的惩罚。

sentences.en: She's asking for at least a $250 million fine.
sentences.zh: 她要求至少2.5亿美元的罚款。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Quarter of a billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 四分之一亿美元。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: She's asking that Trump be permanently barred from doing business in New York.
sentences.zh: 她要求永远禁止特朗普在纽约经商。

sentences.en: Wait, I want to pause on that because that's a very big deal.
sentences.zh: 等等，我想在这个问题上暂停一下，因为这事非同小可。

sentences.en: Trump's business, the Trump organization is based in New York.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的企业——特朗普集团总部设在纽约。

sentences.en: He owns a ton of big buildings in New York.
sentences.zh: 他在纽约拥有大量的大型建筑。

sentences.en: That would be a huge deal.
sentences.zh: 那将是一件大事。

sentences.en: This case strikes at the foundation of Donald Trump's personal image, public image.
sentences.zh: 这个案子触及了唐纳德·特朗普个人形象、公众形象的根基。

sentences.en: This guy is a builder, a businessman, a New York real estate developer.
sentences.zh: 这家伙是个建筑商、商人、纽约房地产开发商。

sentences.en: And this case directly targets that.
sentences.zh: 而这个案子直接针对的就是这一点。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Sounds like this case seeks to basically separate those buildings, that empire, from the man itself.
sentences.zh: 听起来这个案子基本上是想把那些建筑、那个商业帝国与这个人本身剥离开来。

sentences.en: Literally.
sentences.zh: 字面意义上的剥离。

sentences.en: And if James gets her way, by the end of this case, Donald Trump won't be able to do business in New York.
sentences.zh: 如果詹姆斯如愿以偿，到这个案子结束时，唐纳德·特朗普将无法在纽约做生意。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So what happens as this case moves from allegation toward court case and closer and closer to a trial?
sentences.zh: 那么，当这个案子从指控走向法庭诉讼，并且越来越接近庭审时，会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: So because of the nature of this case, the nature of the law that it's brought under, and the kinds of consequences that James is asking for, there's only a judge in this case.
sentences.zh: 由于这个案子的性质、它据以提起的法律性质，以及詹姆斯要求的惩罚种类，这个案子只有法官。

sentences.en: There's no jury.
sentences.zh: 没有陪审团。

sentences.en: So the judge is the ultimate finder of fact.
sentences.zh: 所以法官是事实的最终认定者。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: His name's Arthur F.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫亚瑟·F·

sentences.en: Angoran.
sentences.zh: 安戈隆。

sentences.en: He's quirky.
sentences.zh: 他有点古怪。

sentences.en: He likes to make jokes from the bench.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢在审判席上开玩笑。

sentences.en: He makes all these old timey references, like he referenced Fiddler on the Roof in one ruling.
sentences.zh: 他用了各种老派的典故，比如他在一次裁决中引用了《屋顶上的提琴手》。

sentences.en: Only in New York.
sentences.zh: 只有在纽约才会这样。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 一点没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And in the late summer, early fall, James asks him to rule before the trial on the issues at the heart of the case.
sentences.zh: 而在夏末初秋之际，詹姆斯要求他在庭审前对案件核心问题做出裁决。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And we don't necessarily expect him to do it, but he does.
sentences.zh: 我们本来不一定指望他会这么做，但他真的做了。

sentences.en: He does just that.
sentences.zh: 他偏偏就这么做了。

sentences.en: And what he rules is that the annual financial statements where the values were contained, that those are fraudulent,
sentences.zh: 而他的裁决是，包含资产价值的年度财务报表是欺诈性的，

sentences.en: and that they were repeatedly and persistently used in business.
sentences.zh: 并且这些报表在业务中被反复且持续地使用。

sentences.en: That's the heart of her case right there.
sentences.zh: 这正是她案件的核心所在。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So long before there's a trial, this judge, who is the sole decider of this case, basically finds that the attorney general's case, her allegations are correct.
sentences.zh: 所以在庭审开始很久之前，这位作为本案唯一裁决者的法官，基本上裁定总检察长的指控和陈述是正确的。

sentences.en: It's just a little more chaotic than that.
sentences.zh: 情况比那要稍微混乱一点点。

sentences.en: This is just a week before the trial.
sentences.zh: 这正是在庭审前的一周。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: And what does that mean for the trial as it's approaching?
sentences.zh: 那这对即将到来的庭审意味着什么？

sentences.en: So it means that the issue at the heart of the trial is over.
sentences.zh: 这意味着庭审的核心争议已经结束了。

sentences.en: We had thought this trial is going to be about proving that fraud happened, but we already know that the judge believes that fraud happened.
sentences.zh: 我们原本以为这场庭审会是关于证明欺诈行为的发生，但我们已经知道法官相信欺诈发生了。

sentences.en: So now the trial is really about the consequences.
sentences.zh: 所以现在的庭审实际上是关于惩罚结果的。

sentences.en: This trial is going to be about the judge learning more about how the statements were valued, about how much money the Trumps made from it,
sentences.zh: 这场庭审将围绕法官进一步了解这些报表是如何估值的、特朗普家族从中赚取了多少钱而展开，

sentences.en: all to better determine whether there should be punishments and how severe they should be.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是为了更好地决定是否应该进行惩罚以及惩罚应该有多严厉。

sentences.en: So this is fascinating.
sentences.zh: 所以这太迷人了。

sentences.en: This is basically a trial that Donald Trump and his children have already lost before it begins.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是一场唐纳德·特朗普和他的孩子们在开始之前就已经输了的庭审。

sentences.en: And everything that's going to happen in this trial is just going to be a question of the degree of loss for them.
sentences.zh: 而在这场庭审中即将发生的一切，都只是关于他们失败程度的问题。

sentences.en: A lot of that is true, yeah.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上确实如此，是的。

sentences.en: The stakes are still crazy high for them because the punishments are still at issue, the fine, and really their future as business people, at least real estate business people.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，利害关系依然极其重大，因为惩罚仍在讨论之中，包括罚款，以及真正关乎他们作为商人的未来，至少是房地产商人的未来。

sentences.en: Okay, so this, I think, brings us to the trial and to the testimony of all these Trumps.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我想这把我们带到了庭审以及所有这些特朗普家族成员的作证环节。

sentences.en: And a question I have had as I have watched this trial over the past couple days, which is why would a member of the Trump family, Jonah, testify in this trial?
sentences.zh: 我在过去几天观看这场庭审时一直有一个疑问，那就是，乔纳，特朗普家族的成员为什么要在这次庭审中作证？

sentences.en: We have all come to understand that powerful people don't take the stand.
sentences.zh: 我们大家都已经了解到，有权有势的人是不会出庭作证的。

sentences.en: It's too risky.
sentences.zh: 风险太大了。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And it's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: I think it's a question a lot of people have been asking.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是很多人一直在问的问题。

sentences.en: And it has to do with the nature of the case.
sentences.zh: 这与案件的性质有关。

sentences.en: This is a civil case, not a criminal case.
sentences.zh: 这是一起民事案件，而不是刑事案件。

sentences.en: In a criminal case, the finder of fact, be it the judge or the jury, they can't hold it against a defendant when they decline to testify.
sentences.zh: 在刑事案件中，事实认定者，无论是法官还是陪审团，不能在被告拒绝作证时以此对他们产生不利看法。

sentences.en: They can't assume, oh, they'd be lying.
sentences.zh: 他们不能假设，哦，他们在撒谎。

sentences.en: Oh, they're scared.
sentences.zh: 哦，他们害怕了。

sentences.en: They're prohibited from doing that.
sentences.zh: 法律禁止他们这么做。

sentences.en: Right, if you take the fifth, it can't be held against you.
sentences.zh: 没错，如果你行使宪法第五修正案拒证权，这是不能被用来对付你的。

sentences.en: It's your right.
sentences.zh: 这是你的权利。

sentences.en: In a civil case, they can make what's called negative or adverse inference.
sentences.zh: 但在民事案件中，他们可以做出所谓的负面或不利推论。

sentences.en: They can assume the worst when you don't testify.
sentences.zh: 当你拒绝作证时，他们可以往最坏处想。

sentences.en: If you don't want to testify about this particular lawsuit, well, it may be because you're guilty of every single thing that you're accused of doing in it.
sentences.zh: 如果你不想就这个特定的诉讼作证，嗯，那可能是因为你对其中被指控的每一件事情都负有罪责。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: In other words, the Trumps don't legally have to testify in this case.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，在法律上，特朗普家族并不是非得在这个案子中作证不可。

sentences.en: But if they don't, it's probably going to result in a terrible outcome for them.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们不作证，结果对他们来说可能会非常糟糕。

sentences.en: So in a way, they kind of have to testify.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上说，他们不得不出庭作证。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It'd almost be like forfeiting their case were they not to testify.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不作证，几乎就等于放弃了自己的辩护。

sentences.en: And so this week, one by one, the Trumps arrive in the courtroom.

sentences.zh: 听起来他有点在承认案件核心的那起欺诈本身。

sentences.en: Sometimes he's admitting to parts of the fraud, or at least to his involvement in them.
sentences.zh: 有时他承认了欺诈的一部分，或者至少承认了他参与其中。

sentences.en: But even when he's not doing that, his need for the public to know that his properties are incredibly valuable is on display in so much of his testimony.
sentences.zh: 但即使在不承认的时候，他在这么多证词中也表露出一种迫切的需求，要让公众知道他的房产价值连城。

sentences.en: So we talked earlier about the triplex apartment.
sentences.zh: 所以我们之前谈到了那个三层复式公寓。

sentences.en: Right, the one where he tripled the value of the triplex.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是那个他把复式公寓价值夸大三倍的公寓。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so it's 10,996 feet.
sentences.zh: 所以面积是10996平方英尺。

sentences.en: So at some point, Trump is asked a question, basically, how big is that apartment?
sentences.zh: 所以在某个时刻，特朗普被问到一个问题，基本上就是，那个公寓有多大？

sentences.en: And he starts out by saying it's 11,000 feet.
sentences.zh: 他一开始说有11000平方英尺。

sentences.en: Which is accurate.
sentences.zh: 这很准确。

sentences.en: 11,000 square feet, that's accurate.
sentences.zh: 11000平方英尺，这很准确。

sentences.en: But then he says, or 12,000, 13,000.
He just starts going up.
sentences.zh: 他数字开始往上飙了。

sentences.en: It was like he was doing exactly what he was accused of doing on the witness stand in front of the judge.
sentences.zh: 这就好像他在法官面前的证人席上，完全在重复他被指控的行为。

sentences.en: He sort of can't help aggrandizing and exaggerating this real estate portfolio of his.
sentences.zh: 他有点克制不住地吹嘘和夸大他的这些房地产投资组合。

sentences.en: That's what it seemed like.
sentences.zh: 看起来就是这样。

sentences.en: And it seemed as if so often he was being asked questions that infuriated him.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来，他经常被问到一些让他怒不可遏的问题。

sentences.en: So I'll give you a good example.
sentences.zh: 所以我给你举个好例子。

sentences.en: The judge, as we've talked about, has already ruled that these values were fraudulent.
sentences.zh: 就像我们讨论过的，法官已经裁定这些数值存在欺诈。

sentences.en: And Trump should be doing everything he can to just get away from these statements.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普本该尽一切努力撇清这些报表。

sentences.en: I had nothing to do with them.
sentences.zh: 我跟它们没有任何关系。

sentences.en: I don't have an opinion about them, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 我对它们没有看法，诸如此类。

sentences.en: But sometimes the attorney general's questions just seem calculated to rile him up.
sentences.zh: 但有时总检察长的提问似乎就是为了激怒他。

sentences.en: And he can't do that.
sentences.zh: 而他做不到这一点。

sentences.en: He can't do that distancing.
sentences.zh: 他做不到这种切割。

sentences.en: Kevin Wallace, the attorney general's lawyer, asks,
sentences.zh: 总检察长的律师凯文·华莱士问：

sentences.en: you don't agree with the position of the office of the attorney general that the values are overstated in the financial statements.
sentences.zh: 你不同意总检察长办公室关于财务报表中价值被高估的立场。

sentences.en: And instead of saying, you know, I hope they weren't overstated, but I don't really have anything to do with them.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普没有说，你知道，我希望它们没有被高估，但我其实跟它们没什么关系。

sentences.en: Trump lashes out at James.
sentences.zh: 而是猛烈抨击了詹姆斯。

sentences.en: I think she's a political hack is what he says in response to that question.
sentences.zh: 他在回答那个问题时说，我认为她是个政治傀儡。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And that can show you how his anger almost trips him up rather than being very careful on the stand.
sentences.zh: 这说明他的愤怒往往适得其反，而不是在证人席上谨言慎行。

sentences.en: He goes wherever it seems his id takes him.
sentences.zh: 他的思绪被本能牵着走，随性而至。

sentences.en: That fury, I think, in the political setting has been useful for him, has made people feel like this guy speaks out for me.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这种愤怒在政治环境中对他很有用，能让人们觉得这家伙是在为我说话。

sentences.en: He's with me, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 他和我们站在一起，等等。

sentences.en: That's not the case here.
sentences.zh: 但这里情况并非如此。

sentences.en: Anger makes you lose control.
sentences.zh: 愤怒会让你失去控制。

sentences.en: It makes you overstep lines.
sentences.zh: 它会让你越界。

sentences.en: And overstepping lines in a court case has really serious consequences.
sentences.zh: 而在法庭诉讼中越界会带来非常严重的后果。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And rather than being, it sounds like you're saying, very strategic, Trump misses an opportunity to state unequivocally,
sentences.zh: 听起来你的意思是，特朗普非但没有表现得极具策略性，反而错失了一个明确表态的机会：

sentences.en: I don't agree with those valuations or those valuations might be wrong or, like you said, put some distance between them.
sentences.zh: 我不同意那些估值，或者那些估值可能是错的，或者像你说的，与它们保持一些距离。

sentences.en: His anger overrides what might be a strategic instinct to better serve himself as a defendant.
sentences.zh: 他的愤怒盖过了本能上可能更有利于他作为被告的策略。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: When you see someone on the witness stand, you expect strategy.
sentences.zh: 当你看到有人坐在证人席上时，你期待的是策略。

sentences.en: You kind of expect to see in their conduct what their lawyers have told them about that appearance.
sentences.zh: 你有点期待在他的行为中看到他的律师对他的出庭指导。

sentences.en: There were so many moments on Monday where we didn't see that, where we didn't see preparation, where we didn't see strategy.
sentences.zh: 周一有太多时刻我们没有看到这一点，没有看到准备，也没有看到策略。

sentences.en: It sounds fair to say, correct me if I'm wrong, that by the end of this testimony from Eric, Donald Jr., and Donald Trump himself, that this case is not going very well for them.
sentences.zh: 这样说应该很公平，如果我错了请纠正我，随着埃里克、小唐纳德以及唐纳德·特朗普本人证词的结束，这个案子对他们来说进展得并不顺利。

sentences.en: It wasn't going very well for them the minute they entered the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 他们踏入法庭的那一刻起，进展就不太顺利。

sentences.en: But it sounds like it's not going any better after their testimony.
sentences.zh: 但听起来在他们作证之后，情况并没有变得更好。

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine that this testimony helped them, and it's very easy to imagine little bits and pieces of it showing up in the attorney general's closing.
sentences.zh: 很难想象这些证词对他们有帮助，而且很容易想象其中的零星片段会出现在总检察长的结案陈词中。

sentences.en: Here's where he said this.
sentences.zh: 这是他说过的话。

sentences.en: Here's where he said that.
sentences.zh: 那是他说过的话。

sentences.en: Here's Donald Trump exaggerating that triplex again on the stand.
sentences.zh: 这是唐纳德·特朗普在证人席上再次夸大那个复式公寓。

sentences.en: It seems to me that it was not helpful to their case, and it may have been quite harmful to it.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这对他们的案子毫无帮助，甚至可能相当有害。

sentences.en: It feels like we learned something very important in this testimony about former President Trump as a witness, and it's what you said, which is that he's kind of heedless,
sentences.zh: 感觉我们在这次证词中了解到了关于前总统特朗普作为证人的一些非常重要的事情，正如你所说，他有点无所顾忌，

sentences.en: incautious, and I have to imagine that that is a fact that prosecutors in all the other cases in which Trump is a defendant are thinking about.
sentences.zh: 不知轻重，我不得不认为，特朗普作为被告的所有其他案件中的检察官们都在考虑这个事实。

sentences.en: They want Trump on the stand.
sentences.zh: 他们希望特朗普出庭作证。

sentences.en: If I were a prosecutor and I saw what happened on Monday, I would absolutely want the former president to testify in my case.
sentences.zh: 如果我是检察官，看到周一发生的事情，我绝对会希望前总统在我的案子里作证。

sentences.en: And, of course, the question for future cases is, will his lawyers advise him to behave differently?
sentences.zh: 当然，对于未来的案件，问题是：他的律师会建议他采取不同的行为方式吗？

sentences.en: Will he listen to them?
sentences.zh: 他会听他们的吗？

sentences.en: And will they now try to keep him off the stand?
sentences.zh: 他们现在会试图阻止他出庭作证吗？

sentences.en: It was so clear on Monday that he did not understand the pulse of the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 周一的情况非常明显，他根本不理解法庭的氛围。

sentences.en: What makes it tick?
sentences.zh: 是什么在驱动着它？

sentences.en: If I'm one of Trump's criminal lawyers, and I see what happened on Monday and two of his criminal lawyers at least were in the courtroom,
sentences.zh: 如果我是特朗普的刑事辩护律师之一，看到周一发生的事情——他的刑事辩护律师中至少有两人在法庭上——

sentences.en: I really try hard to keep him off the stand.
sentences.zh: 我会竭尽全力阻止他出庭作证。

sentences.en: Well, Jonah, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，乔纳，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Donald Trump's daughter, Ivanka, is scheduled to testify today.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普的女儿伊万卡计划于今天出庭作证。

sentences.en: The trial is expected to last for the next few weeks, with a final ruling possible sometime in December.
sentences.zh: 审判预计将持续未来几周，最终裁决可能会在12月的某个时候作出。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Who should govern Gaza when this is over?
sentences.zh: 这一切结束后，谁来治理加沙？

sentences.en: I think Israel will, for an indefinite period, will have the overall security responsibility because we've seen what happens when we don't have it.
sentences.zh: 我认为以色列将在一段不确定的时期内承担整体安全责任，因为我们已经看到了如果没有这种责任会发生什么。

sentences.en: In an interview on Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 在周二的一次采访中，

sentences.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told ABC News that Israel would play a major role in overseeing security in Gaza when its ground invasion is completed.
sentences.zh: 以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡告诉美国广播公司新闻网，当地面进攻结束时，以色列将在监督加沙安全方面发挥主要作用。

sentences.en: When we don't have that security responsibility, what we have is the eruption of Hamas terror on a scale that we couldn't imagine.
sentences.zh: 当我们没有这种安全责任时，迎来的便是哈马斯恐怖主义以我们无法想象的规模爆发。

sentences.en: The remarks immediately evoked memories of Israel's original occupation of Gaza, which began in 1967 and ended in 2005.
sentences.zh: 这些言论立刻勾起了人们对以色列最初占领加沙的回忆，那场占领始于1967年，结束于2005年。

sentences.en: The United States has strongly opposed such a reoccupation, but in the interview, Netanyahu did not specify what his plan for securing Gaza would actually look like in practice.
sentences.zh: 美国强烈反对这种重新占领，但在采访中，内塔尼亚胡并未具体说明他在实践中保障加沙安全的计划究竟是什么样的。

sentences.en: And Democratic candidates and causes won big victories on Tuesday in off-year elections held in several states.
sentences.zh: 民主党候选人和各项议题在周二几个州举行的非大选年选举中取得了重大胜利。

sentences.en: In Kentucky, the popular Democratic governor, Andy Beshear, was re-elected in a deeply Republican state.
sentences.zh: 在肯塔基州，广受欢迎的民主党州长安迪·贝希尔在一个深红的共和党州成功连任。

sentences.en: In Ohio, which also leans Republican, voters approved two ballot measures, the first enshrining abortion rights in the state's constitution, the second legalizing marijuana.
sentences.zh: 在同样倾向共和党的俄亥俄州，选民批准了两项投票提案，第一项是将堕胎权写入该州宪法，第二项是将大麻合法化。

sentences.en: And in Virginia, Democrats kept control of the state Senate and were on the verge of winning control of the House of Delegates,
sentences.zh: 而在弗吉尼亚州，民主党人保持了对州参议院的控制，并即将赢得众议院的控制权，

sentences.en: blocking the state's Republican governor from trying to restrict abortion.
sentences.zh: 从而阻止了该州共和党州长试图限制堕胎的企图。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Diana Nguyen and Olivia Natt.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由黛安娜·阮和奥利维亚·纳特制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Rachel Quester, with help from Brendan Klinkenberg, contains original music by Dan Powell, and was engineered by Alyssa Jane Moxley.
sentences.zh: 由蕾切尔·克斯特编辑，布兰登·克林肯伯格协助，包含丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，由阿丽莎·简·莫克斯利担任工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lantzler of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰茨勒创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了群自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 此后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱且有时惊心动魄的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都会》的最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格将带你聆听那些试图维持影响力却在过程中失控的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都会》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
